title: REPORT on the 2024 budget – assessing the implementation of the gender mainstreaming methodology in the EU budget
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘mandatory suspension or’ and ‘through clear indicators or’
part_context: Urges the Commission to establish a ‘gender equality safeguard mechanism’ as a standard part of the EU’s legislative procedures, which would require the <del>mandatory suspension or</del> revision of any proposal that, through clear indicators or through the analysis of the Court of Auditors, is shown to undermine the EU’s gender equality strategy and objectives;
